State flow

Every pixel's system is integrated to t = 20 and coloured by where it is now, on a chart: press Play or drag the playhead and the picture flows. At t = 0 on the view's own chart it is the legend itself. Hover or tap a pixel to mark where its system is now, on the legend. A prototype of the state map (principia_state_map.md); the charts and their extension are the trace demo's.

Legend

The panel is the stain graph: a source, the colour slot, the brightness slot, Replace-L. Chart position is where each pixel's own system is at the playhead, on the chart chosen. The source is a node: Chart position works on every chart, the shape sphere included, and its colour slot is a base (Gradient, Site blend, Palette or Picture) with layers on top (grid lines, checkerboard, tile or cell edges, stripes, rings, site dots). Shape n̂ is the existing node, with its own colouring, unchanged (try Classic shape colour). At t = 0 on the view's own chart the picture is the colouring itself; then it flows.
